Ajusta o plano de energia que estiver at: Adjusts the active power plan (preferably Gueibs Optimizer Performance) so it doesn't save energy on anything that can cause stutters: sleep, timed hibernation, turning off the display and the disk, USB selective suspend, PCIe link power saving and lowering the minimum CPU clock.
Baixo. Mais consumo e calor com o PC par: Low. More power use and heat while the PC is idle. It doesn't stop you from sleeping or shutting down manually.
Botão Desfazer ou aba Restauração: volta: Undo button or Restore tab: each value (plugged in and on battery) goes back to what it was. Switching power plans also undoes it, because the values live in the plan.
Energia no máximo: sem suspensão e sem d: Maximum power: no sleep and no display turn-off
More power use while the PC is idle. You can still sleep or shut down from the Start menu.
Notebook detectado: só o modo na tomada: Laptop detected: only the plugged-in mode is changed; on battery Windows keeps saving energy.
No plano de energia ativo: o PC nunca su: On the active power plan: the PC never sleeps or hibernates on its own, the display and disk never turn off on a timer, and USB, PCIe and CPU get no power saving.
Os valores anteriores são lidos com powe: The previous values are read with powercfg /q before changing.
Sem quedas de clock nem dispositivos USB: No clock drops or USB devices "falling asleep" during games; the display doesn't turn off in long controller sessions or videos.

Aplica os ajustes recomendados (risco Ba: Applies the recommended tweaks (Low and Medium risk). Everything can be undone in the Restore tab. Results depend on the hardware.
Criar ponto de restauração antes de muda: Create a restore point before changes
Ligado (recomendado): o Boost, os níveis: On (recommended): Boost, performance levels, profiles, Debloat, the guided setup and Medium-risk fixes create a Windows restore point before changing anything. Off: changes are made directly, faster. Even when off, each tweak keeps its own undo in the Restore tab; the restore point is an extra layer of safety. The Dashboard's Create point button and the integrity check option keep working.
